fullContentHtml:
NCERT Non Teaching LDC Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : National Council of Education Research and Training (NCERT) has released the Result for the recruitment of Non Teaching Group A, B, C. This recruitment was released for 173 posts. Applications for the NCERT Group A, B, C Recruitment 2026 were accepted from December 27, 2025, to February 02, 2026. The examination was held on 15 May 2026. Candidates who appeared in this examination can download their NCERT Non Teaching LDC Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 December 2025
  • Last Date : 02 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 24, 25 & 27 March 2026
  • Exam Date (Various Posts) : 27, 28 & 29 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 23 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 30 April 2026
  • Exam Date (LDC) : 15 May 2026
  • Admit Card (LDC) : 12 May 2026
  • Answer Key (LDC) : 19 May 2026
  • Result LDC : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Level 10-12 Posts) : Rs. 1500/-
  • General, EWS, OBC (Level 6-8 Posts) : Rs. 1200/-
  • General, EWS, OBC (Level 2-5 Posts) : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
